about: Descriptions of neighbouring skills an agent runtime might list beside this one. A trigger case passes when the iXBRL description outranks all of them; a negative case passes when it does not. Part of the eval harness: changing this file requires a re-freeze.

skills.name: spreadsheets
skills.description: Use when creating, reading, editing or analysing spreadsheets: xlsx, csv, formulas, pivot tables, charts, conditional formatting, financial models, budgets and data cleaning in Excel-compatible workbooks.

skills.name: pdf
skills.description: Use when reading, extracting text and tables from, filling forms in, merging, splitting, OCR-ing or generating PDF documents, including scanned annual reports and invoices.

skills.name: chart-of-accounts
skills.description: Use for bookkeeping questions: choosing a ledger account, mapping a chart of accounts to a reference chart, journal entries, debit and credit, VAT codes, trial balance, year-end closing entries and general ledger structure for small businesses.

skills.name: xml-schema
skills.description: Use when writing or validating generic XML and XSD: namespaces, schema validation errors, XPath and XSLT transforms, DTDs, xmllint, SOAP payloads and converting XML to JSON.

skills.name: financial-analysis
skills.description: Use when analysing company financial statements: ratios, valuation, discounted cash flow, earnings quality, comparing balance sheet and income statement trends across peers, and summarising an annual report for investors.

skills.name: tax-returns
skills.description: Use for personal and small-business income tax returns: deductions, allowances, filing deadlines, self-assessment, VAT returns, payroll tax and how to complete a tax form.

skills.name: web-frontend
skills.description: Use when building web pages with HTML, CSS and JavaScript: layout, accessibility, responsive design, React components, rendering tables, and fixing browser display bugs.

skills.name: data-visualization
skills.description: Use when making charts, dashboards and plots: choosing a chart type, colour palettes, axis scales, legends, sparklines and KPI tiles in any plotting library.
